nodes.label: GD Focus Business OS
nodes.rationale: Central operating system for a janitorial company transitioning from subcontracting to direct commercial/government contracts.

nodes.label: Phase 1 - Central Business Repository
nodes.rationale: Build one structured source of truth before adding AI; incremental, avoid over-engineering.

nodes.label: COMMBUYS search (no API, CSV export scrape)
nodes.norm_label: commbuys search (no api, csv export scrape)
nodes.rationale: No official API; reuses geocoding helpers with sam_gov_service; risk that a COMMBUYS redesign breaks it.

nodes.label: Manual Lead to Opportunity Conversion (v1)
nodes.rationale: Do not auto-convert every website form into a contract opportunity

nodes.label: Federal Data Integration Pipeline skill
nodes.rationale: Standardizes search -> filter -> geocode -> import of federal API data into Supabase so every module reuses one pattern.

nodes.label: authenticated_full_access RLS policy
nodes.rationale: Decided 2026-09-24: data is shared between owner and spouse because it is one business, so no user_id filtering.

nodes.label: Check live database first (step 0)
nodes.rationale: Migration files in git may not be applied; Opportunities broke because migration 0008 was never applied (fixed by 0009).

nodes.label: Secure Module Bootstrap skill
nodes.rationale: Checklist to ship new Phase 1 modules safely: live schema check, migration applied, blueprint, CSRF, RLS, live-DB test before push.

nodes.label: Self-Improvement Loop
nodes.rationale: Each failure: identify, fix the tool, verify, update the workflow, move on.

nodes.label: WAT framework (Workflows, Agents, Tools)
nodes.rationale: Probabilistic AI handles reasoning while deterministic tools handle execution; 90% per-step accuracy compounds to 59% over five steps.

nodes.label: AdminLTE 4 UI
nodes.rationale: Decided 2026-09-07: vendored prebuilt CSS/JS, no Node build step, fits server-rendered Flask/Jinja.

nodes.label: AI architecture philosophy (code vs LLM vs agent)
nodes.norm_label: ai architecture philosophy (code vs llm vs agent)
nodes.rationale: Use normal code for predictable rules, LLMs for unstructured interpretation, agents only when dynamic tool choice is required.

nodes.label: Deterministic, auditable pricing
nodes.rationale: LLMs may extract pricing variables but must not invent prices; formulas stay visible and editable.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-loop (AI prepares, owner approves)
nodes.rationale: Financial, contractual, legal and submission decisions stay under owner control; the system assists rather than impersonates.

nodes.label: Lawrence, MA radius filter
nodes.rationale: Hard constraint: all opportunity data filtered by geographic distance from Lawrence, MA (default 50 mi, 10-150 adjustable), never by state.

nodes.label: No third-party federal MCP servers
nodes.rationale: Third-party gov-contracts MCP had security issues; own SAM.gov integration is lower risk.

nodes.label: Manual progress tracking (roadmap_data.py)
nodes.rationale: Owner can update dashboard progress by editing one dict without coding.

nodes.label: Login rate limiting (Flask-Limiter)
nodes.rationale: In-memory storage is not shared across Vercel serverless invocations, so the limit is best-effort.

nodes.label: Quote Form Lead Fields

nodes.label: Commercial-only Janitorial Positioning
nodes.rationale: Prioritize recurring janitorial contracts over residential/one-time work

nodes.label: No Invented Claims Rule
nodes.rationale: Use only verified business info; no fake certifications, testimonials or stats
